note: Level plan v3 (TASK-414). Per class, an ordered list of slices. A farm slice is a band [entry, exit] in which the bot farms its areas; exit is inclusive and is the level from which a later slice pays more XP per minute (AREAMON table, internal/levelplan/areaxp.csv). A quest slice names a chapter of data/campaign/normal.json and carries no levels: the journey decides when it goes (its floor and recommended rows), the plan only farms between quests. Gates of a farm slice: clvl >= entry (+ no_merc_add without a living merc), and below kit_clvl only with a full kit. They choose where to farm; they never wall a chapter. active=false: the bot keeps progression-normal.json for that class and the rows are for the simulation and review only.
